apps.name: Mumbai One
apps.summary: Official all-in-one public transport app for Mumbai: suburban rail, metro, bus and monorail journey planning plus QR ticketing.
apps.tripUse: Use this first for public transport planning and tickets across Mumbai.

apps.name: Google Maps
apps.summary: Live traffic, walking and transit navigation, Street View and downloadable offline maps.
apps.tripUse: Use for street-level navigation, live traffic and offline map backup.

apps.name: Uber
apps.summary: Cab, auto and group rides for last-mile or luggage-heavy transfers; Mumbai Metro 2A/7 ticketing is also integrated.
apps.tripUse: Use for Bandra Terminus luggage transfers, late-night rides and any route where public transport is inconvenient.

apps.name: Chalo
apps.summary: Live bus tracking and mobile bus ticketing in Mumbai, with some schedule information available offline.
apps.tripUse: Use when BEST bus is the best local option or when you want live bus arrival information.
